```{r ,echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, cache=FALSE, warning=FALSE, fig.height=9,fig.width=7,out.width="100%"}

library(patchwork)
library(ggplot2)
panel_pheno_swapped = readRDS("../Data/Working_files/panel_pheno_swapped.rds")
panel_abundance_swapped = readRDS("../Data/Working_files/panel_abundance_swapped.rds")
panel_trait_swapped = readRDS("../Data/Working_files/panel_trait_swapped.rds")

panel_abundance_swapped <- panel_abundance_swapped +
  theme(
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x  = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank()
  )

panel_trait_swapped <- panel_trait_swapped +
  theme(
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x  = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank()
  )

library(patchwork)

final_plot_col <- 
  panel_abundance_swapped /
  panel_trait_swapped /
  panel_pheno_swapped +
  
  plot_layout(
    ncol = 1,
    guides = "collect"
  ) &
  
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    
    # Increase axis text size
    axis.text.x  = element_text(size = 13),
    axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 13),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 14),
    
    # Optional: slightly stronger tick labels
    axis.text    = element_text(colour = "black"),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 15, face = "bold"),
    legend.text  = element_text(size = 14),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"),

    plot.margin = margin(5,5,5,5)
  )

final_plot_col



```
